about.title: Sanger Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Sanger's local roads carry a steady mix of Highway 180 traffic, farm equipment, and everyday commuters, and that mix shows up in the crash record: recent data counts 30 injury collisions and 46 people hurt in a single year, with a traffic death among them. Corridors like Bethel Avenue and Annadale Avenue see regular collision activity, and Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. tend to bring more reported crashes than other times of the week. If you were hurt in one of these collisions, what happens in the days right after matters. Insurance adjusters often call quickly, and what you say in that first conversation can affect your claim later. LawProactive doesn't practice law or charge you anything — we simply connect you with an independent personal injury attorney in the network who can review what happened, explain your options under California law, and handle communication with insurers so you can focus on recovering.
commonInjuries: Cuts, bruising, and soft tissue damage

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to the Insurer

items.title: California's Fault Rules Are Complicated
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash. An attorney can help make sure an insurer isn't unfairly shifting more blame onto you than the facts support.

items.title: Deadlines Are Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: California generally allows two years to file a car accident lawsuit, but claims against a government entity — such as a city road defect — can require notice in as little as six months. Waiting to get advice can quietly close doors.

items.title: Recorded Statements Can Work Against You
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may ask for a recorded statement soon after the crash, but you're not required to give one. An independent attorney can speak for you and help preserve evidence like photos, witness contacts, and crash reports before details fade.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.

items.question: My crash happened on Jensen Avenue during Friday rush hour — does that matter?
items.answer: It can help establish the timeline and conditions of your case, since Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. are a period when Sanger sees more reported crashes. An attorney can use traffic patterns, witness accounts, and any available records to help reconstruct what happened.

items.question: What if the insurance company already asked me for a statement?
items.answer: If you haven't given a recorded statement yet, it's worth speaking with an attorney first, since anything you say can be used to minimize your claim. If you already gave one, an attorney can still review the situation and help protect your interests going forward.
